# RCC Royal Car Cleaning

> RCC Royal Car Cleaning is a professional mobile vehicle cleaning service based in Zürich and available throughout Switzerland. RCC brings cleaning equipment directly to the customer's location, at home, at the workplace, or another address. Services include interior cleaning, exterior cleaning, and complete vehicle detailing. RCC also serves companies, business vehicles, and vehicle fleets. Locations more than 30 km from Zürich may incur an additional travel fee. The exact amount depends on the destination and is communicated before confirmation.

**Brand:** RCC – Royal Car Cleaning  
**Market:** Switzerland / Schweiz / Suisse  
**Service type:** Mobile professional vehicle cleaning (no fixed wash station)  
**Phone:** +41 78 880 38 84  
**Email:** Info@royalcarcleaning.ch  
**Address:** Wechselächerstrasse 25, 8103 Zürich, Switzerland  
**Price range:** CHF 85 – 400  
**Social:** Instagram @royalcarcleaning.ch · TikTok @royalcarcleaning.ch
